items.quote: Paul went down, threw himself on the young man and put his arms around him. “Don’t be alarmed,” he said. “He’s alive!”
items.contrast: The pronoun “he” refers to the young man, not to Paul, who is speaking.
items.reason: The preceding actions center on the young man, and verse 12 confirms that the people took the young man home alive. The question clearly tests pronoun reference.
